patients.gender:
SELECT gender, COUNT(gender) AS count FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.gender IS NOT NULL AND  p.id {PATIENT_IDS} GROUP BY gender;
patients.inclusionage: SELECT cast(p.inclusionage as TEXT), count(p.inclusionage) as count from Patient p where p.inclusionage is not null and p.id {PATIENT_IDS} GROUP BY inclusionage

study.studykohorte: SELECT AFFILATION_STUDY as studykohorte, COUNT(*) as count FROM Study s join visit v on s.visit_id = v.id join patient p on v.patient_id = p.id WHERE visit_id {VISIT_IDS} and p.id {PATIENT_IDS} GROUP BY AFFILATION_STUDY;
study.study: SELECT AFFILIATION_TTU_TI as study, COUNT(*) as count FROM Study s join visit v on s.visit_id = v.id join patient p on v.patient_id = p.id WHERE s.visit_id  {VISIT_IDS} and p.id {PATIENT_IDS}  GROUP BY study;
study.orgout: select CONCAT(org_unit, '#', AFFILIATION_TTU_TI, '#', AFFILATION_STUDY) as orgout, COUNT(*) as count from Study s join visit v on s.visit_id = v.id join patient p on v.patient_id = p.id WHERE s.visit_id  {VISIT_IDS} and p.id {PATIENT_IDS}  GROUP BY orgout

transplat.total:
SELECT 'samples' as key, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as count 
  FROM TRANSPLANTATION t join  patient p on t.patient_id = p.id WHERE p.id {PATIENT_IDS}
transplat.transplantout: SELECT transplantation as transplantout, COUNT(*) as count FROM TRANSPLANTATION t join patient p on t.patient_id = p.id WHERE p.id {PATIENT_IDS}  GROUP BY transplantout;
